_comment: All tunable numbers live here (SRS v1.1 CON-08, FR-085). The app refuses to start if a value is invalid (FR-086).

aggregation._modes: A = confidence-weighted (default), B = equal-weight mean, C = majority vote

weights._update_every_note: SRS default is 1000 labelled outcomes; 100 so the demo shows movement

gateway._trusted_proxy_note: true only when a reverse proxy you control sets X-Forwarded-For / X-User-Id (ADD-32)

auth._cookie_secure_note: set true when the dashboard is served over HTTPS
